finalText:
All 625 tests pass and `verify.js` confirms the fix is legitimate.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` was computing tax on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount (despite the comment above it saying tax should apply after the discount). Changed `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`. Only rows with both a discount and a tax nonzero were affected, which is why most of the wall of text was passing noise.
